text:
Happy afternoon planning team,
After dinner, the arrivals lead noted a detail about welfare walks

I am sharing a brief reminder for the Companion Animal Travel Desk so our next handoffs stay calm and consistent. The travelers and their animals rely on us to keep the process clear, and our tone should remain steady, courteous, and reassuring at every step. <<FACT F085>> Please continue to check that each case is read carefully, that the records are complete, and that any uncertainty is raised early rather than carried forward.

For arrival pickup, timely coordination remains important, and the desk should keep its notes aligned with the wider team. <<FACT F095>> When a pet is in our care, small details matter, so please confirm welfare walk arrangements, crate handling, and the final handover notes with care. If there is any sign that a record may be incomplete, pause and verify it before moving on, as a careful pause now is better than a correction later.

Thank you for your attention to these steps and for the steady standard you bring to Aurelia Skyways each day. Your careful work helps every animal feel secure and every traveler feel supported.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
